common.deleteBody: This cannot be undone. Records that use it keep their copy.

fieldErrors.invalid_analyte_code: Start with a letter; letters, digits, _ . % # only
fieldErrors.formula_required: A calculated analyte needs a formula
fieldErrors.future_date: The date is in the future
fieldErrors.after_to: The start is after the end

errors.range_overlap: Two ranges overlap for the same sex, specimen and analyzer. Fix the highlighted rows.
errors.range_invalid: Some range rows are invalid. Fix the highlighted rows.
errors.formula_cycle: The formula refers back to itself: {{detail}}
errors.analyte_code_in_formula: Other formulas use this code ({{detail}}). Change them first.
errors.analyte_has_results: Results already exist for this analyte, so its type cannot change. Deactivate it instead.
errors.test_ordered: This test has been ordered before. Deactivate it instead of deleting.
errors.package_ordered: This package has been ordered before. Deactivate it instead.
errors.in_use: Still in use by other records, so it cannot be deleted.
errors.payer_in_use: Orders use this payer. Deactivate it instead.
errors.doctor_in_use: Orders reference this doctor. Deactivate instead.
errors.last_admin: At least one active user must keep the right to manage staff.
errors.cannot_disable_self: You cannot disable your own account.
errors.system_role: System roles cannot be deleted. You can change their permissions.
errors.role_in_use: Users still have this role. Move them to another role first.
errors.method_in_use: Payments use this method. Deactivate it instead.
errors.main_branch_required: Mark another branch as the main branch first.
errors.svg_too_large: The logo must be 100 KB or smaller.
errors.svg_not_svg: The file is not an SVG image.
errors.svg_script: The logo contains a script and was refused.
errors.svg_event_handler: The logo contains event handlers and was refused.
errors.svg_foreign_object: The logo embeds HTML (foreignObject) and was refused.
errors.svg_embedded_content: The logo embeds another document and was refused.
errors.svg_external_ref: The logo links to outside files or images. Export it as plain vector shapes.
errors.svg_doctype: The logo has a DOCTYPE or entity declarations and was refused.
errors.svg_too_complex: The logo is too complex. Simplify it and try again.
errors.session_already_open: You already have an open cash session.
errors.session_closed: This cash session is already closed.
errors.not_your_session: Only the cashier or a supervisor can close this session.
errors.refund_exceeds_paid: The refund is larger than what was paid on this invoice.
errors.amount_exceeds_balance: The amount is more than the balance due.
errors.own_request: With segregation of duties, another person must decide your own request.
errors.idempotency_conflict: This request was already used for another payment. Refresh and try again.
errors.range_too_long: Choose a period of at most 400 days.
errors.not_failed: Only failed messages can be retried.

analytics.title: Reports and statistics
analytics.description: Turnaround, workload, revenue, staff productivity, rejected samples, analyzers and referring doctors. Every tab exports to Excel.

tat.phasesHint: Median time of each step for the tests validated in this period
tat.byTestHint: Most validated tests first; target is the test's turnaround in the catalog

volume.byWeekday: Orders by day of the week

revenue.byDayHint: Net billed after discounts; collected after refunds

productivity.resultsHint: Results entered, technically verified and medically validated in this period

rejections.rateHint: Rejected ÷ received or rejected in the period
rejections.none: No rejected samples in this period.

instruments.title: Analyzers
instruments.hint: Messages, results and quality control in this period

doctors.none: No referred orders in this period.

catalog.title: Test catalogue
catalog.description: Tests, analytes and reference ranges, packages, departments, specimens and tubes.

tests.emptyHint: Add the tests the lab performs, with their tube, price units and turnaround.
tests.editorHint: The code is printed on labels and used by analyzers; keep it short.

sections.sampleHint: Tests with the same specimen and tube share one tube at collection.

fields.unitsHint: Price = units × the payer's unit price
fields.fixedPriceHint: Leave empty to price by units
fields.notesHint: Preparation, stability or other notes for the staff

tests.switchesHint: Favourite tests appear first when registering orders.
tests.analytesHint: In the order they print on the report. Use the arrows to reorder.
tests.analytesEmpty: No analytes yet. A test needs at least one to receive results.
tests.neverOrdered: Not ordered yet; it can still be deleted.
tests.deleteBody: The test is removed from the catalogue and its packages.
tests.deleteOrdered: This test has orders, so it cannot be deleted. Turn it off (inactive) instead.

analytes.editorHint: Save the definition first, then add its reference ranges.
analytes.createdNext: Analyte added. Now enter its reference ranges.

fields.deltaHint: Flag a change larger than this from the previous result

analytes.typeLocked: Results exist for this analyte, so the server will refuse a type change.
analytes.optionsHint: Staff pick one of these when entering the result. Mark the normal answers in the reference range.
analytes.formulaHint: Calculated from other analytes of the same order; recalculated when they change.
analytes.saveFirst: Save the analyte first, then add its reference ranges here.
analytes.unsavedBody: Your changes to this analyte or its ranges will be lost.
analytes.deleteBody: The analyte and its reference ranges will be deleted.
analytes.deleteHasResults: Results exist for this analyte, so it cannot be deleted. Turn it off (inactive) instead.

formula.empty: Write the formula with analyte codes, e.g. CHOL - HDL - TG / 5.
formula.cycle: The formula refers back to itself: {{path}}
formula.age: AGE: the patient's age in years
formula.help: Operators + − × ÷ ^ and comparisons; if(condition, then, else) chooses a value. Click a code to insert it.

ranges.hint: The most specific row applies: specimen, then analyzer, then sex, then the narrowest age band.
ranges.emptyHint: Without a range, results are not flagged high or low.
ranges.expectedHint: Separate with /, e.g. Negative or Yellow/Pale yellow
ranges.gapsHint: Results in these ages will not be flagged. Add rows if the test is done for them.
ranges.noGaps: Every age is covered for each sex.
ranges.savedWithGaps_one: Saved. One age gap has no range.
ranges.savedWithGaps_two: Saved. {{count}} age gaps have no range.
ranges.savedWithGaps_few: Saved. {{count}} age gaps have no range.
ranges.savedWithGaps_many: Saved. {{count}} age gaps have no range.
ranges.savedWithGaps_other: Saved. {{count}} age gaps have no range.

issues.overlap: Overlaps row {{other}} (same sex, specimen and analyzer)
issues.age_order: The upper age is below the lower age
issues.critical_order: Critical low must be below critical high
issues.empty_row: Enter limits or a text range
issues.critical_low_inside: Critical low is above the normal low
issues.critical_high_inside: Critical high is below the normal high

packages.emptyHint: Packages group tests ordered together, like a general check-up.

modeHints.sum: The package costs what its tests cost on their own.
modeHints.units: The package has its own units; price = units × the payer's unit price.
modeHints.fixed: The same price for every payer.

packages.sumUnits: Its tests add up to {{n}} units.
packages.deleteBody: The package is removed; its tests stay in the catalogue.

fields.capHint: Shown on labels and worklists so staff pick the right tube.

simple.deleteInUse: Still used by {{n}} record(s); the server will refuse to delete it.

department.title: Departments
department.description: Bench sections; each test belongs to one. Worklists and turnaround reports group by them.

sample_type.title: Specimen types
sample_type.description: What is collected: serum, whole blood, urine…

container.title: Tubes and containers
container.description: The cap colour marks the tube type only, never a status.

rejection_reason.title: Sample rejection reasons
rejection_reason.description: Chosen when a sample is rejected at the bench; reported in the rejection statistics.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: {{lab}} at a glance: today's work, results that need attention and money.

pipeline.title: Work in progress
pipeline.description: Right now, across all open orders. Click a stage to open its work page.

criticals.title: Open critical results
criticals.description: Critical values from the last 7 days with no documented call yet.

tat.title: Turnaround time
tat.description_zero: Receipt → validation. No tests validated in this period.
tat.empty: Turnaround appears once tests are validated.

overdue.title: Overdue tests
overdue.description: Received tests past their target turnaround and not yet validated.

charts.revenue14Hint: Net billed (after discounts) and cash in (after refunds), per day
charts.payerMixHint: General public, insurers and client labs

doctors.title: Doctors
doctors.description: Referring doctors and the work each one sends to the lab.
doctors.newHint: Doctors appear in the referral list at the front desk.
doctors.clinicHint: Clinic or hospital name and area.
doctors.activeHint: Inactive doctors stay on old orders but are hidden at the desk.
doctors.deleteUsed: Orders reference this doctor, so the record cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
doctors.emptyHint: Add the doctors who refer patients so orders can be credited to them.

referrals.empty: No referred orders in this period
referrals.emptyHint: Choose a longer period, or record the referring doctor at the desk.

cashier.title: Cash desk
cashier.description: Open your cash drawer, take payments on unpaid invoices, record expenses paid from the drawer, and close with a count.
cashier.quickExpenseHint: Paid from the drawer, it lowers the expected cash
cashier.searchDue: Name, phone, order or invoice number
cashier.noDueHint: Every invoice is paid in full.
cashier.noRead: Your role can open and close the cash drawer but not list invoices.

session.title: My cash drawer
session.hint: Open the drawer with the cash you start with. Cash payments need an open drawer.
session.expectedHint: float + cash in − cash refunds − cash expenses
session.closeHint: Count the cash in the drawer and enter the amount.
session.countHint: Everything in the drawer, including the float

pay.title: Take a payment
pay.cashHint: Cash goes into your open drawer.

refund.title: Refund money
refund.methodHint: Cash comes out of your open drawer

invoices.title: Invoices and accounts
invoices.description: Every invoice with its balance, statements for insurers and client labs, and the cash drawer history.
invoices.search: Invoice, order, file number or name

statements.noPayers: No insurers or client labs yet
statements.noPayersHint: Add them under Prices and payers.
statements.none: No invoices for this payer in this period

sessions.none: No cash drawers in this period

expense.title: Expenses
expense.description: What the lab spends: salaries, reagents, rent, electricity and the generator, maintenance. Drawer expenses come out of a cashier's cash.
expense.fromDrawer: Paid in cash from my drawer
expense.noDrawer: Not from a cash drawer (open your drawer to pay from it).
expense.drawerOpen: Your cash drawer is open; drawer expenses lower its expected cash.
expense.locked: Part of a closed cash drawer; it cannot be removed.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: Discounts and free tests asked for at the desk wait here. An approved discount is applied to the invoice at once.
approvals.segregationOn: Segregation of duties is on: nobody decides their own request.
approvals.ownRequest: Your own request: someone else must decide it.
approvals.applyHint: The discount is spread over the tests and the patient's balance drops accordingly.
approvals.recordOnly: Only the decision is recorded; the requester then carries it out.
approvals.nonePendingHint: Discount requests from the desk will appear here.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every change in the lab, who made it and when. Entries are chained by fingerprints, so editing or removing one in the database shows up when the chain is verified.
audit.intactBody: {{n}} entries checked at {{at}}; none was changed or removed.
audit.broken: The chain is broken at entry #{{seq}}
audit.brokenHint: Report this to the lab owner: the database was changed outside Natija.

reason.hash_mismatch: Its stored content no longer matches its fingerprint.
reason.chain_break: It does not follow the entry before it: an entry was removed or inserted.

audit.noDetails: No details were recorded for this action.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: SMS, email and WhatsApp messages the lab sends to patients and doctors.
messages.simulatedBody: No SMS or email provider is connected, so these messages are recorded but not delivered. WhatsApp messages are sent from the desk.
messages.noneHint: Report links and notices sent to patients appear here.

pricing.title: Prices and payers
pricing.description: Each test is worth a number of units; each payer group has its own unit price, patient share and discount.

payers.intro: General public, insurer plans, client labs and unions. A test's price = its units × the unit price, unless it has a fixed or special price.
payers.newHint: A price tier: the public, an insurer plan, a client lab, a union.
payers.termsHint: The contractual discount comes off first; the patient pays their share of the rest at the desk and the payer is billed for the remainder.
payers.onAccountHint: The payer settles later from a monthly statement (insurers, client labs).
payers.activeHint: Inactive payers stay on old orders but cannot be chosen for new ones.
payers.deleteUsed_zero: No orders use this payer group.
payers.deleteUsed_one: One order uses this payer group, so it cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
payers.deleteUsed_two: {{count}} orders use this payer group, so it cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
payers.deleteUsed_few: {{count}} orders use this payer group, so it cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
payers.deleteUsed_many: {{count}} orders use this payer group, so it cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
payers.deleteUsed_other: {{count}} orders use this payer group, so it cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.

bulk.title: Change unit prices
bulk.description: Raise or set the unit price of several payer groups at once. Existing orders keep their prices.
bulk.percentHint: Use a minus sign to lower prices, e.g. −10.
bulk.roundHint: Rounds each new unit price to the nearest step.
bulk.reasonHint: Kept in the audit log, e.g. "2027 price list".
bulk.note: Special prices and fixed prices are not changed.
bulk.nothing: The new prices are the same as the old ones.

list.fixedHint: fixed price set on the test
list.unitsHint: Other prices are units × the payer's unit price.

overrides.intro: A special price replaces units × unit price for one test and one payer group, e.g. an agreed insurer price.
overrides.empty: No special prices for this payer
overrides.emptyHint: Every test follows units × unit price.
overrides.deleteBody: New orders for this payer go back to the usual price. Existing orders keep their prices.

settings.title: Lab settings
settings.description: Identity and branding, report and workflow rules, payment methods and branches.

profile.identityHint: Shown on the sign-in page, receipts and every report.
profile.directorHint: Printed under the signature on released reports.
profile.currencyHint: Amounts are stored as numbers; changing the currency does not convert existing prices or invoices.
profile.timezoneHint: Days, reports and the daily order numbers follow this clock.

brand.title: Brand colour
brand.description: Used for the lab tile, the report letterhead and printed headings.

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: SVG vector logo, checked and cleaned before it is used.
logo.readFailed: The file could not be read.
logo.limits: SVG only, up to 100 KB. No scripts, embedded images or external links.
logo.removeBody: Reports and the app will show the lab's initial on the brand colour instead.

reports.title: Report settings
reports.description: How released reports are printed and sent to patients.
reports.languageHint: Test names, units and comments follow this choice.
reports.bilingualHint: Test names in both languages, the usual choice in Syria.
reports.footerHint: Printed at the bottom of every page: opening hours, branches, disclaimers.

workflow.title: Workflow
workflow.description: Rules every bench and desk follows. Changes apply at once.
workflow.segregationHint: The person who enters a result cannot validate it, and nobody approves their own discount or refund request.
workflow.collectionHint: Tubes must be marked as collected before the bench can receive them.
workflow.deltaDaysHint: Compare each result with the patient's previous one from this many days back.
workflow.digitsHint: Numbers in Arabic pages and printed reports.
workflow.defaultLanguageHint: For new staff accounts and the patient portal. Each user can still switch.
workflow.usd: Show amounts in US dollars too
workflow.usdHint: Receipts and statements show the dollar equivalent next to the lab currency.
workflow.usdRateHint: How many {{currency}} one dollar is worth.

methods.title: Payment methods
methods.description: Cash methods count towards the cash drawer; others are reported separately.
methods.codeHint: Short code, e.g. CASH or CARD.
methods.cashHint: Cash payments need an open cash session.
methods.cashLocked: Payments already use this method, so cash / non-cash cannot change.
methods.deleteUsed: Payments use this method, so it cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.

branches.title: Branches
branches.description: Collection points and branches; orders and cash sessions can be tied to a branch.
branches.mainHint: Only one branch is the main one; choosing this one moves the mark.
branches.mainLocked: The main branch cannot be deleted. Mark another branch as main first.
branches.deleteUsed: Orders, cash sessions or staff use this branch, so it cannot be deleted.

staff.title: Staff and roles
staff.description: Accounts, roles and what each role may do. Changes apply at once.

temp.done: I have given it to them
temp.once: This temporary password is shown only once. Give it to {{name}} in person, not by message.
temp.change: After signing in they should choose their own password from My account. Their other sessions are signed out.

users.newHint: A temporary password is created and shown once.
users.usernameHint: Used to sign in; cannot be changed later.
users.title: Title
users.departmentScopeHint: Limit worklists to these departments. Leave all unticked for every department.
users.branchScopeHint: Limit the desk to these branches. Leave all unticked for every branch.

confirm.disableBody: They are signed out on every device at once and cannot sign in until enabled again. Their work stays in the records.
confirm.enableBody: They can sign in again with their current password.
confirm.resetBody: A new temporary password is created and shown once. Their current password stops working and they are signed out everywhere.
confirm.unlockBody: The account was locked after five wrong passwords. Unlocking lets them try again now.

roles.newHint: Give the role a name, then tick its permissions in the table.
roles.keyHint: Short identifier, e.g. night_shift. Cannot change later.
roles.copyFromHint: Copies that role's permissions; you can change them afterwards.
roles.note: Permission changes take effect immediately for everyone with the role, even if they are signed in. System roles can be edited but not deleted, and at least one active user must keep “Manage staff and roles”.
roles.clean: Tick or untick to change a role, then save.
roles.deleteBody: Only custom roles that nobody holds can be deleted.
